```{r}
library(tidyverse)

setwd("C:/Users/lwojd/Vs Projects/seniorThesisRepo/code/R Studio/stormReports")
getwd()

#keep begin_day, year, month_name, event_type, tor_f_scale, begin_lat, begin_long

files <- list.files(pattern = "*.csv", full.names = TRUE)
  
files %>%
  map (~ {
    df <- read_csv(.x)
    
    df <- df %>%
      filter(STATE == "OKLAHOMA") %>%
      filter(EVENT_TYPE %in% c("Hail", "Tornado", "Heavy Rain", "Funnel Cloud", "Thunderstorm Wind")) %>%
      arrange(BEGIN_YEARMONTH) %>%
      mutate(
        BEGIN_TIME = str_pad(BEGIN_TIME, width = 4, side = "left", pad = "0"),
        BEGIN_HOUR = str_sub(BEGIN_TIME, 1, 2),
        BEGIN_DAY = str_pad(BEGIN_DAY, width = 2, side = "left", pad = "0"),
        BEGIN_MONTH = str_sub(BEGIN_YEARMONTH, 5, 6),
        DATE = paste(YEAR, BEGIN_MONTH, BEGIN_DAY, sep = "-"),
        LAT_IDX = as.integer( (BEGIN_LAT - 33.6) / 0.25),
        LON_IDX = as.integer( (-103 - BEGIN_LON) / -0.25)
        ) %>%
      arrange(BEGIN_MONTH, BEGIN_DAY, BEGIN_HOUR) %>%
      select(DATE, BEGIN_MONTH, BEGIN_DAY, BEGIN_HOUR, EVENT_TYPE, TOR_F_SCALE, LAT_IDX, LON_IDX )
      
    df_unique <- df %>% distinct()
    
    new_name <- str_replace(.x, ".csv", "_oklahoma.csv")
    
    write_csv(df_unique, new_name)
  })

  
 
```
